subject.title: fix(cli): offer config repair after invalid startup

question: Should interactive invalid-config startup offer `openclaw doctor --fix` with default-yes consent, allowing Enter to repair configuration before one retry?
rationale: This is an intentional operator-facing behavior and upgrade-policy choice: the patch preserves headless safety, but it changes a prior fail-and-instruct flow into a default-yes configuration repair prompt.

options.title: Approve default-yes recovery
options.body: Keep the proposed prompt default because it remains consent-gated, avoids headless mutation, and limits the retry to one attempt.

options.title: Require explicit yes
options.body: Change the prompt default to no if invalid-config repair should require an affirmative operator action rather than Enter.

recommendation.title: Approve default-yes recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed prompt default because it remains consent-gated, avoids headless mutation, and limits the retry to one attempt.
